prompt:
Rewrite snippets/store-address-block.liquid so it renders a store address card with a rounded distance label. Inputs (all top-level; there is no section object): - `address`: object or null. When it is an object it always has exactly these keys: `name`, `street`, `zip`, `city`, `country`. Each value is a string or null. - `distance_m`: integer >= 0, or null. This is the distance to the store in metres. Address lines: - Strip leading and trailing whitespace from every address value. A value that is null, or empty after stripping, is missing. - When `address` is null, all lines are missing. - There are up to four lines, in this order: 1. name 2. street 3. locality: zip and city joined by a single space ("10115 Berlin"). If only one of them is present, use that one alone. If neither is present, the line is missing. 4. country - Each present line is HTML-escaped (& < > " become & < > "). Missing lines produce no output. Distance label (only when `distance_m` is not null). Use integer arithmetic only: - If distance_m < 1000: " m", for example "999 m" or "0 m". - Otherwise compute tenths = (distance_m + 50) integer-divided by 100. This rounds half up to one decimal place of kilometres. - If tenths < 1000: ". km" using integer division. Examples: 1049 gives "1.0 km", 1050 gives "1.1 km", 9950 gives "10.0 km" and 99949 gives "99.9 km". - If tenths >= 1000: show whole kilometres rounded half up, (distance_m + 500) integer-divided by 1000, followed by " km". There is no decimal part. Examples: 99950 gives "100 km", 150499 gives "150 km" and 150500 gives "151 km". Output: - If no address line is present and there is no distance label, output nothing (an empty string). - Otherwise output exactly this, with no whitespace or newlines between any tags: `
` then one `LINE` per present line, in the order above, then, if there is a distance label, `LABEL`, then `
`. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/store-address-block.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
